senses.gloss: sevā, cf. Tamil sevai, śervai (SITI); service; inām for services; tax-free land given to servants for enjoyment in lieu of salary.
Sevaka (SITI), a soldier; cf. sevaka-ttevai (SITI), expenses in connection with the supply and maintenance of retainers of chiefs and officers during their visit to a place.
śeviḍu (SITI), Tamil; a small grain measure; (1/5) of an āl̤̣ākku.
śevaka-kkāśu (SITI), Tamil; fee for the maintenance of the soldiers; or, tax levied on the soldier.
